correctness.rationale: A center-free dissociation set of the fan \(K_1\vee P_n\) is exactly a binary path incidence word with no occurrence of 111, while a center-containing set may use at most one path vertex. The suffix decomposition 0, 01, 011 gives the three-term weighted recurrence. Decomposing a size-k path set into b blocks of lengths one or two gives the stated binomial coefficient formula. The maximum number of ones in a 111-free word is \(\lceil2n/3\rceil\), and substitution in the block formula yields the three residue-class counts of maximum sets. The inspected exhaustive checker independently verifies all coefficients and extremal counts for path sizes 2 through 17.
residual_risks: The theorem is restricted to ordinary dissociation sets on the standard fan family.
